about.title: A calendar, a memory, a gallery.
about.lead: Genuflexio brings together the liturgical calendar and the artistic heritage it has inspired: the feast of the day, the lives of the saints, and the masterpieces devoted to them.

manifesto.title: Giving the calendar back its faces
manifesto.p1: Every day of the year carries a name, a story, a colour. For centuries, painters, sculptors and illuminators have given these names a face. Genuflexio sets out to reconnect them.
manifesto.p2: Neither a devotional app nor an art catalogue, it sits at the crossroads: a quiet place to consult the celebration of the day, follow the thread of the saints through the centuries, and contemplate the works they inspired.
manifesto.quote: Not all who wander are lost.

0.title: Rigour
0.text: Dates, ranks and liturgical colours follow the official calendars. Each calendar is documented and sourced.

1.title: Openness
1.text: The works reproduced are in the public domain. The data is shared freely, and everyone is welcome to contribute.

2.title: Restraint
2.text: No ads, no tracking, no noise. Just a page that does what it says, on every screen.

credits.title: Built with care
credits.text: Genuflexio is an independent project. Images come from museums and institutions that release their collections into the public domain. Liturgical data is compiled from official calendars.
